paragraphs: First Arriving sells a real-time information platform that connects the critical systems an agency already runs. The site claims 1400+ Fire, EMS, Law Enforcement & Local Government Agencies as users. The same information shows up at the station on the big screen, in the office on a desktop, and on a tablet in the field.

The platform centralizes data from 130+ systems into one operational view. Connected sources include CAD, RMS, staffing, fleet, facilities, GIS, scheduling, training, and alerts. Alerts can be pushed with required acknowledgments so the right people act immediately. Individual user accounts and role-based views mean each member of a team sees what they need.

The law enforcement version is designed for police departments, sheriff's offices, campus safety, and agencies of all sizes. It carries things like daily shift briefings and watch commander notes. A local government version covers council meetings, facility schedules, emergency alerts, and public notices. Lobbies, public counters and reception areas are named as display locations. The company notes that its marketing division is now ResponderMAX.

quote.text: One Platform. Every Screen. Your Whole Department.
